title: Chapter 1197 - 15 Ten Years (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1197 - 15 Ten Years (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1197: Chapter 15 Ten Years (Request for Subscription)_2

In this Fang Yuan World, an ordinary Heavenly Venerate is equivalent to a Chaos Great Saint of the Chaos Void, while a Peak Venerable matches an unparalleled Great Saint.

The power of Red Flame Venerable has essentially reached the level of an Invincible Great Saint from the Chaos Void. In fact, among the Peak Venerables of the six Ancient Countries, there surely exists a Heavenly Venerate comparable to an Invincible Great Saint.

An Invincible Great Saint from the Chaos Void rarely appears throughout a long Cosmic Era, but in this Fang Yuan World? The thirteenth-tier ancestral bloodline rebirth for descendants is exceptionally high.

In the Chaos Void, as long as an unparalleled Great Saint masters a thirteenth-tier inheritance, they would likely possess the strength of an Invincible Great Saint.

Take, for instance, the Magic Jade Tower Master. The reason for becoming an Invincible Great Saint was the comprehension of the essential nature after slaying that wondrous creature with a concentrated bloodline of time, reaching the threshold to cultivate a certain thirteenth-tier inheritance, eventually becoming invincible in that era.

But in this Fang Yuan World, which Heavenly Venerate from the various Ancient Countries hasn’t been exposed to thirteenth-tier inheritances? Although difficult to master, the likelihood of producing a Heavenly Venerate at the Invincible Great Saint level is certainly far higher than in the Chaos Void.

The spread of thirteenth-tier inheritances among time creatures in the Chaos Void is entirely random, often forbidden, and acquiring them relies entirely on luck.

...

"Next, let’s continue to solidify the Seed of the Fierce Sun."

Lin Yuan split some of his mental focus, attempting to solidify more Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

This technique greatly augments his combat power, surpassing many historical royal members who have consolidated numerous Seeds of the Fierce Sun, so Lin Yuan naturally values it highly.

...

With the passage of time.

The birth of a new first-class treasure land rapidly spread throughout the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Many Great Lords-level powerhouses were thrilled, although the exotic treasures produced by the first-class treasure land are surely prioritized for the Heavenly Venerable layer of the Ancient Country’s powerhouses.

Yet as long as the Fierce Sun Ancient Country can seize this first-class treasure land, the Heavenly Venerates can feast while the Great Lords can at least drink some soup.

Soon.

Representing the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the list of twelve Heavenly Venerates heading to the new treasure land for contention was made public.

Among them, eleven Heavenly Venerates didn’t stir much commotion, being veteran Peak Venerables like the established Red Lotus Venerable.

But the last one is the recently prominent Galaxy Venerate?

"Galaxy Venerate? Isn’t he just entering the Heavenly Venerable Realm?"

"Though Galaxy Venerate is the first to achieve Heavenly Venerate as a royal descendant through ancestral bloodline, allowing him to take part in the contention for a first-class treasure land?"

"You don’t understand; before the list was confirmed, Galaxy Venerate had sparred with Red Lotus Venerate, and although it resulted in a draw, Red Lotus Venerate publicly stated that Galaxy Venerate’s strength is comparable to his."

"My heavens? How long has Galaxy Venerate been in the Heavenly Venerable Realm? Can he already par up with such a Peak Venerable as Red Lotus Venerate?"

"Perhaps this is the prowess of the ancestral bloodline..."

...

The many Great Lords-level powerhouses discussed endlessly, though many questioned Galaxy Venerate’s inclusion in the list, upon learning the sparring result with Red Lotus Venerate, they were amazed.

...

Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Lin Yuan was sitting face-to-face with King Chibao.

"Congratulations, Galaxy Venerate." King Chibao’s expression was somewhat respectful: "Initially, upon first meeting the Venerate, I even fought with you..."

King Chibao sighed.

"Just call me Galaxy." Lin Yuan smiled and shook his head.

Upon just entering the capital, had it not been for King Chibao’s continual care, he might have encountered many detours.

"That’s not possible, you’re now a Heavenly Venerate, how could I call you Galaxy with the other Heavenly Venerates watching?"

King Chibao immediately replied.

Although he belongs to a core royal lineage and can spar a few moves with a Heavenly Venerate, that refers to ordinary Heavenly Venerates.

As for a Peak Venerable? Naturally not a match, Lin Yuan being on par with Red Lotus Venerable among the Peak Venerables, his strength far surpasses King Chibao’s.

"I didn’t expect that, initially sent to aid Qingfen Domain, but ended up bringing back for the Ancient Country..." King Chibao expressed wistful.

...

Ever since Lin Yuan entered the Fierce Sun Capital, taking over the Galaxy Royal Mansion,

many royals have come to visit.

A considerable portion intended to rely on Lin Yuan.

"Do you aim for me to establish the eighteenth royal branch?" Lin Yuan smiled as he looked at a middle-aged man in white before him.

The middle-aged man had a robust aura, at the peak of Great Lord realm, showing utmost respect when facing Lin Yuan.

"Heavenly Venerate, with your strength, if willing, the eighteenth branch you establish will dwarf the other seventeen branches, creating a substantial impact within the Ancient Country."

The middle-aged man said softly.

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country currently comprises seventeen royal branches,

each branch having supreme core royals stationed.

Outside the seventeen royal branches, numerous scattered royals exist, straying from the core of the Ancient Country, upon seeing Lin Yuan, a core royal descendent from above, and having transformed his ancestral bloodline to a Heavenly Venerate level, desired to cling tightly.

"I’m not interested in founding a new royal branch."

Lin Yuan directly stated, currently intending to focus all efforts on cultivation, to better advance to the thirteenth tier.

Regarding founding a new royal branch? If Lin Yuan achieves the thirteenth tier, it would not be merely founding a branch but establishing the seventh Ancient Country of this source world.

If unable to cross into the thirteenth tier? At Lin Yuan’s rate of cultivation, any established force would lag far behind his growth.

Lin Yuan would also make many arrangements before attempting the thirteenth tier to ensure the continuity of human civilization within the Chaos Void.

"But..."

The middle-aged man in white intended to say more.

"Dismissed."

Lin Yuan waved his hand, and the man in white was directly moved out.

...

Numerous royal members visited Lin Yuan.

Beyond attachment, more sought guidance and counsel.

"Heavenly Venerate, for us to delve deeper into our ancestral bloodline and break the limits?" asked a royal who had comprehended the path of Chaos Evolution power.

This royal, titled Red Cloud King, was also a core royal member, facing limits in growth, opted to understand the principles of the grand path, ultimately comprehending Chaos Evolution power crossing into Heavenly Venerable realm.

"Continue nurturing the fundamental power within bloodline depths..." Lin Yuan generously shared, the Martial Arts Evolution Road’s refinement of the bloodline stemmed from the Body Cultivation lineage.

And the Body Cultivation lineage highly emphasizes nurturing the bloodline.

"Fundamental power?" Red Cloud King fell into contemplation.

"I will elaborate further on nurturing methods when this treasure land contention is over."

Lin Yuan looked at Red Cloud King.

He intended to establish the dissemination time of the Martial Arts Evolution Road branch after the contention for the first-class treasure land.

"Heavenly Venerate’s integrity." Red Cloud King expressed admiration.

He could discern that Lin Yuan truly intended to elaborate on nurturing the bloodline.

Logically, such secret, other Heavenly Venerates would likely conceal and hold tightly.

Yet Galaxy Venerate openly shared, making Red Cloud King ashamed.

After Red Cloud King departed,

Lin Yuan began reassessing the Martial Arts Evolution Road branch.

Through Lin Yuan’s modifications, the branch suitable for dissemination in this Fang Yuan world essentially abandoned the internal cosmos method.

No choice, many strong figures of the Chaos Void could accept origin infusion, internal world, internal cosmos growth was almost inevitable.

However, in this Fang Yuan world, within the six Ancient Countries, internal world, internal cosmos is far from easily attainable, certainly far from common.

Lin Yuan could still cultivate internal cosmos in this world because he had undergone it numerous times, comprehending the opening fully, backed by strength and ample resources.

Even so, lacking several origin infusions from the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan’s internal cosmos remains weaker than his true self in the Chaos Void, if not for the Fierce Sun Divine Body and Fierce Sun Seeds providing boosts.

The true self in this source world simply cannot match the true self in the Chaos Void in combat strength.

...

"Whether internal cosmos or rule comprehension, as long as the core remains unchanged, it’s the Martial Arts Evolution Road, the more beings cultivate it, the more anchor points and path markers they provide me."

Lin Yuan pondered, closing his eyes, re-entering cultivation and insight.

Time gradually passed.

A decade blinked by.
